context:
STYLE BIBLE (mandatory for every image concept) — "The Independent Bill Auditor"
Flat ledger surfaces, engineering-blueprint feel. NO gradients, no glassmorphism, no 3D renders, no stock-photo people smiling at bills. Monospaced type is the voice of numbers. Palette: ink #0e201c, cream paper #fffcfa, faint grid-teal #3c655c scaffolding, amber #e8a33d reserved for THE ONE LINE THAT MATTERS (a highlighted figure, the key step, the flagged charge). Charts render data honestly; annotations look hand-entered by an auditor. Human figures, when used, are distant/schematic, never decorative.

IMAGE MECHANICS ON THIS SITE
- Hero: frontmatter `image:` field; file under static/images/articles/<slug>/; display is full intrinsic aspect ratio (16:9 or 3:2 both fine). Two pages also support `hero_below_answer: true`.
- In-body editorial figures: {{< visual src="/images/articles/<slug>/<name>.webp" alt="honest descriptive alt" caption="optional" wide="16:9-or-wide" >}} — responsive figure, honest alt mandatory.
- Legacy: {{< image src=... alt=... caption=... >}} also in use.
- Product visuals: product-box shortcode auto-renders the visual from data/product_images.yaml keyed by ASIN (already exists: B0C7B1LKDW -> /images/products/whole-home-energy-monitor.webp "Illustrative whole-home electrical energy monitor kit"; B0D5BBYRJM -> /images/products/learning-thermostat.webp "Illustrative learning smart thermostat"). Inline product text links: {{< amazon asin="..." text="..." >}}.
- AFFILIATE RULE (Commander, binding): any image whose subject is a product we recommend must be affiliate-wired — inside/near a {{< product-box >}} or wrapped in a {{< amazon asin=... >}} link. NEVER a bare un-monetized figure of a recommended product. AI product images must be visually accurate to the REAL product (form factor, sensor count, display) — invent NO features, packaging, branding, claims, or specs; "Illustrative" labeling convention applies.
- New filenames: /images/articles/<slug>/<kebab-name>.webp; orientation guide: 3:2 standard body, 16:9 wide (wide= param) for full-width moments, ~square for product cards.

IMAGE TYPES (classify every recommendation): editorial (scene/photo-style) · illustrative (flat house-style diagram/explainer) · screenshot-style (generic mock bill/tariff excerpt — NO real utility names or logos, fabricated amounts must match on-page verified examples only) · AI-product (accurate-to-real-product, affiliate-wired).

VISION PROTOCOL (use your read_image tool — this is the core of the audit)
1. For EACH assigned page: locate the hero file (frontmatter image: -> static<path>), read_image it, and write a 1-2 sentence GROUNDED description of what you actually see, then judge: (a) topic-relevant to THIS article's post-SQ-055 content? (b) consistent with the style bible? (c) suitable as hero, or better demoted/kept?
2. read_image every existing in-body visual on your pages (07-gas has 2, electric-bill-breakdown has 2 — paths inside the .md) — does each still earn its place next to the updated text?
3. NEVER describe an image you did not read. If a file is missing or unreadable, say so — that is a finding.
